scope: Partial D06/D07 private configuration and PostgreSQL metadata foundation; no production installation, live ingress/browser HTTPS, coordinated online restore, durable jobs, project roles, expert isolation, independent reproduction or release/customer qualification.

environment.dependency_delta: psycopg and psycopg-binary 3.3.6; other previously qualified public core dependencies unchanged
environment.data: Disposable synthetic PostgreSQL/Redis and temporary artifact/secret/session fixtures, public core without optional SDK. Provider key blank, engine unavailable and telemetry disabled.

checks.name: Full SQLite marked backend suite, Ruff, migration drift and pip consistency
Private TLS middleware/session/API and metadata smoke
checks.evidence: HTTP redirects, invalid Host rejection, secure session/CSRF cookies, HSTS, anonymous and missing-CSRF denial, real sign-in, pipeline JSON, UUID receipts/grants/access events/expired approval records, protected artifact hash parity. Migrations/writes use a database-owning non-superuser with no CREATEDB. This uses the real Django test client, not live TLS ingress or a browser.

checks.name: Database TLS negative checks
checks.evidence: Bad CA connection fails specifically with certificate verify failed; reachable unnamed host fails specifically with does not match host name. No weakening of verify-full or SQLite fallback.

checks.name: Restart and quiescent synthetic snapshot/restore
checks.evidence: pg_dump/pg_restore into a separate fixture database plus matching artifact copy; restart and restored database preserve session validity, exact pipeline JSON, grant UUID/revision, access and holdout receipts, expired approval state and protected artifact hashes. Not an online coordinated restore or SQLite-to-PostgreSQL migration.

checks.name: Configuration regression cases
checks.evidence: Included in both final full suites: weak/ambiguous secret inputs, invalid files, host/origin/profile settings, SQLite fallback, TLS downgrade modes, artifact root, IPv6 and live-reload private-start rejection.

checks.name: Static script checks and development Compose validation

qualification_corrections: The first disposable harness seed failed because pathlib.Path.open does not accept opener; replaced with builtin open and reran the fixture.

First PostgreSQL full run exposed FileResponse.close/request_finished inside a test-wrapping atomic transaction. The existing session-boundary test now uses transaction=True, retaining all assertions and exercising real autocommit. Both final full suites pass.
ci: Adds PostgreSQL runtime and metadata as a sixth job with private TLS, restart/restore and full PostgreSQL pytest at the existing skip/coverage gates. The existing five jobs remain. Exact-head checks are recorded by the PR, separately from local evidence.
limitations: No customer capacity, delivery-date or acceptance claim.
Development default remains SQLite; existing metadata is not transferred automatically.
Private deployment WSGI/ASGI/TLS/static/offline/encrypted packaging is not delivered or qualified.
No Celery/durable-worker, interrupted-job recovery, cancellation, online coordinated restore or upgrade/rollback qualification.
REST project authorization, egress/retention, expert gVisor isolation, independent reproduction and all release/customer gates remain open.
Final fixture-controller lint and owned-runner cleanup changes retain check semantics; the final host runner is independently exercised by the new exact-head CI job.
